# `PromptGetContext`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\PromptGetContext`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Interceptor/PromptGetContext.php)

Everything an interceptor may inspect about one prompts/get: the prompt
name, the arguments as sent by the client (SDK-internal keys stripped),
the MCP session carrying initialize-handshake data, and the client
identity resolved by \Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\SharedSecretMiddleware
(never the raw secret).

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|---|---|---|
| `promptName` | `string` | yes |
| `arguments` | `array` | yes |
| `session` | `?Mcp\Server\Session\SessionInterface` | yes |
| `clientId` | `?string` | yes |

## Methods

```php
getClientInfo(): array
```

Client identity from the initialize handshake (name, version, …);
